correctness.rationale: The frozen-composition two-state transition chain has conditional stationary h_beta(c)=c^beta/(1-c+c^beta). Differentiating gives N_beta(p) with N_beta'<0 on (0,1) for beta>=2, N(0)>0>N(1), hence one inflection p_beta. A local fourth-order binomial/Taylor bound with exp-small tails gives g(Eh(K/g)-h(p)) -> p(1-p)h''/2 for fixed interior p; boundary substitution t=beta(1-p)=log beta-loglog beta+a gives normalized N -> 1-exp(-a), bracketing root. Independent stationary balance and beta=2,3,5,10,100,1000 numeric root checks corroborate. It does NOT address evolving strategies, uniform in p, or finite-g exact crossing locations.
